description.p: Helena is a free, open-source, no-cloud API client for testing and exploring HTTP APIs — a devs-for-devs tool with no paid or hosted features.

ul.li: Collections, folders, and requests stored as plain YAML on disk
Request chaining and sandboxed pre/post-request scripting
OpenAPI / Swagger / WSDL import and cURL / wget export

description.p: Bug-fix release. OpenAPI/Swagger and Postman imports now populate request bodies, join URLs without a double slash, and name the environment after the spec's server. Pre-request scripts can no longer hang the app or exhaust memory, a stalled WebSocket server no longer freezes it, and the Microsoft Store taskbar icon drops its blue plate.
Packaging fix: the Microsoft Store bundle now uses the reserved product name "Helena API Client". The application itself is unchanged from 0.5.0.
A status bar with an opt-in update check, an About-dialog tribute to Helena the cat, Help-menu Website and Buy-me-a-coffee links, a brief saving spinner on close, and roomier open/save dialogs.

First tagged release. Request history, folder-scoped collection runs, machine-readable JSON/JUnit run reports, a native Windows-on-ARM binary, and a quit-with-unsaved-edits confirmation, plus a batch of correctness and security fixes.
